interface.signature: s: str, t: str, k: int -> bool

preconditions.description: The lengths of strings s and t must be equal.
The number of moves k must be within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must contain only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'true' if canConvertString(s, t, k) else stdout == 'false'
postconditions.description: The output must be 'true' if it is possible to convert s into t in k moves or less, otherwise 'false'.
